description:
READ-ONLY 'how's my server?' - the on-demand health surface (ask your agent this
    any time). Reuses health_check (Odoo systemd + HTTP) and queries Netdata's LOCAL
    API (127.0.0.1:19999) for currently-active alarms + a disk/RAM/CPU snapshot and the
    per-instance service states. Multi-instance aware via `instances=['acme',...]`.
    Changes nothing; needs monitoring_setup to have run for the alarm data.
name: monitoring_status
